questions.question: __________ is a collection of data values of same types having a common name.
questions.solution: It is array which stands for data value of same types having a common name such as integer. It is an efficient way to arrange memory, for example in search engine; web pages are stored in array, which is then found in a search performed by the user.

questions.question: The process of depositing a layer of any desired metal on another material by means of electricity is called _________.
questions.solution: It is Electroplating, which involves process of depositing a layer of any desired metal on another material by means of electricity. In this case, the electric current is used to reduce dissolved metal cations such they form a thin metal coating on electrode.

questions.question: Who invented the waterproof raincoat?
questions.solution: Charles Macintosh invented the waterproof raincoat. He was a Scottish chemist, and made waterproof garments by using rubber dissolved in coal tar Naphtha for cementing two pieces of cloth together.

questions.question: In which sport did India win Silver medal at Rio Olympics 2016?
questions.solution: It is in the sports of badminton that India has won Silver Medal at Rio Olympics 2016. This medal was won by P.V. Sindhu, who then became the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal. Additionally she is one of the two shuttlers, other being Saina Nehwal, to have won medal in Olympics.

questions.question: "Central Bureau of Intelligence and Investigation" is listed in the __________ list given in the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India.
questions.solution: *In the Union list, given in the seventh schedule of the Constitution of India, CBI* is listed implying Union government as the final authority with *regards* to the appointment, termination of services, subjects to be picked up for investigation*,* and so on. Additionally, CBI is *attached* under the Ministry of Personnel Public grievance and Pension.

questions.question: Which National Park in Nepal is a continuation of India's Valmiki National Park?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Chitwan National Park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Chitwan National Park:

__
 
• Chitwan National Park of Nepal is the continuation of India’s Valmiki National Park, which is located in the West Champaran District of Bihar.
 
• Located near northwestern Bihar, this national Park is an excellent example of the Terai landscape, which is characterized by swamps and marshy land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Bandipur National Park:

__
 
• Bandipur National Park, an 874-sq.-km forested reserve in the southern Indian state of Karnataka__ is known for its small population of tigers.
 
• Once the private hunting ground of the Maharajas of Mysore, the park also harbors Indian elephants, spotted deer, gaurs (bison), antelopes, and numerous other native species.

Dudhwa National Park:

 
• Dudhwa Tiger Reserve was established in the year 1987. 
 
• It is spread over the areas of the Lakhimpur and Bahraich districts of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Total area: 1093.79 km sq.
 
• It shares its north-eastern boundary with Nepal.
 
• It is home to 400 bird species, including cheetahs, elephants, tigers, leopards, swamp deer, etc.

Jim Corbett National Park:

 
• Jim Corbett National Park is the largest tiger reserve located in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand.
 
• It was established in the year 1936.
 
• It is famous for being home to a large number of tigers, the highest among any Indian national park.
 
• The Park itself occupies 520 square kilometers, and its whole area comprises hills, marshy depressions, riverine belts, grasslands, and a large lake.
 
• It is India's oldest and most prestigious National Park.

questions.question: Animals in which the cells are arranged in three embryonic layers are called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Triploblastic**__.

 
 

 **Layer**
 **Characteristics**
 
 

 Triploblastic
 
 
 
• It is in the Triploblastic form of animals that the embryo is arranged in a **three-layered structure. **
 
• These layers are e**ctoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm.**
 
• Most multicellular animals are triploblastic except** sponges and coelenterates.**
 
 
 
 

 Diploblastic
 
 
 
• The term diploblastic refers to animals that have a body derived from only** two embryonic cell layers,** the ectoderm, and the endoderm.
 
• Examples of diploblastic animals are – **jellyfish, corals, sea anemone, etc. **
 
• The bodies of more complex animals are triploblastic, having developed from mesoderm as well as endoderm and ectoderm germ layers.
 
 
 
 

 Ectoderm
 
 
 
• The ectoderm is a germ layer( tissue layer), that forms in an animal embryo during development.
 
• The ectoderm is the germ layer that covers the outside of the embryo (**'ecto' meaning outside)**.
 
• The ectoderm gives rise to a number of both internal and external structures.
 
 
 
 

 Endoderm
 
 
 
• The endoderm gives rise to the **epithelium** of the pharynx, including the Eustachian tube, the tonsils, the thyroid gland, parathyroid glands, and thymus gland), the urinary bladder, the vagina (in females), and the urethra.

questions.question: If the ___________ firm has zero costs or only has fixed cost, the quantity supplied in equilibrium is given by the point where the average revenue is zero.
questions.solution: Under perfect competition, at equilibrium, price equals marginal cost. In this case when only fixed cost is there, the marginal cost will become zero and thus under equilibrium, price (that is average revenue or marginal revenue) will be equal to zero.Hence equilibrium will be at a point where price equals marginal cost which equals to zero that pertains to perfect competition firm.

questions.question: The average variable cost curve is _______ shaped.
questions.solution: In the graphical representation, Average variable cost curve is U shaped. It is so because initially the cost of variable inputs like labour is more than the return from it, and as the production goes on this cost reduces Vis a Vis its return. However, after the point, productivity goes downhill and the cost again escalate. Thus, it is for this reason that U shaped curve occurs.

questions.question: What type of image formed by a concave mirror on the screen when the distance between object and mirror is higher than the focus?
questions.solution: A concave mirror forms a real image on the screen when the distance between object and mirror is greater than the focal length. It forms a virtual image when the distance between the object and mirror is less than the focal length.

questions.question: ___________ is a straw coloured, viscous fluid constituting nearly 55 per cent of the blood.
questions.solution: It is the plasma that comprises 55% part of the blood is a straw colored, viscous fluid. It holds the blood cells, which makes it the extracellular matrix. Moreover, it also serves as the protein reserve of the human body.

questions.question: In 1918, Mahatma Gandhi went to __________ to organise a satyagraha movement amongst cotton mill workers.
questions.solution: It is in __**Ahmedabad**__ that Gandhiji organized Satyagraha for cotton mill workers. This strike took place as the Workers was getting a mere 20% wage hike as against their demand of 50%. Ultimately, due to the hunger strike called upon by Gandhiji the wages got a 35% hike.

questions.question: Murshid Quli Khan, Alivardi Khan and Sirajuddaullah were all nawabs of __________?
questions.solution: It is to the state of Bengal that Murshid Quli Khan, Alivardi Khan and Sirajuddaullah belonged. Moreover, after the reign of Aurangzeb, the Mughal Empire started to disintegrate, and seeing the weak administration in the Delhi, Murshid Quli khan carved out his own semi-independent Bengal province, to which the rest of the aforementioned belonged.

questions.question: _________ affect(s) the rate of humus formation of soil.
questions.solution: It is the presence of flora and Fauna that plays an important role in soil formation. As humus refers to the organic decomposed part of soil, that provides essential nutrients to plants, it is logical that it requires organic material in the form of flora and fauna for its build up.

questions.question: __________ refers to the number of births during a given period in the population that are added to the initial density.
questions.solution: It is the Natality, which refers to the number of births during a given period in the population. It is a key factor in determining whether a population is increasing, decreasing or staying the same.

questions.question: The latitudes of main land of India extend between ________.
questions.solution: It is from 8°4' N and 37°6' N that comprises the latitudinal extend of mainland India. Additionally, in terms of distance, India spans around 3214 km north-south whereas from east to west it is 2933 km.

questions.question: The distance-time graph for the motion of an object moving with a constant speed is a __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is a __**Straight Line**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A straight line is used to depict objects moving at a constant speed.
 
• It is so as there is no variation in speed, and change in time and distance happens at a constant rate, which makes the curve a straight line.
 
• Speed is defined as the rate of change in distance with time.
 
• So, speed = Distance/Time
 
 
• where the unit of distance is the kilometer and the unit of time is the hour.
 
 
 
• Therefore, a unit of speed = kilometer/hour

questions.question: Who was the architect of Taj Mahal?
questions.solution: It was Ustad Ahmad Lahouri from Persia, who was the chief architect behind the construction of the magnificent Taj Mahal. While designing Taj Mahal he has tried to combine the Persian, Islamic and Mughal architecture to give Taj Mahal its splendour look, and its construction took place from 1632 to 1648.

questions.question: The Nobel Prize in Literature 2016 was awarded to?
questions.solution: It was Bob Dylan who won the Noble Prize for Literature in 2016. He is the only songwriter to have won this award so far. Additionally he is an American musicians, whose music became quite popular and an anthem for the Civil Rights Movements and anti-war movement.

questions.question: In April 2017, amid rising tension over North Korea, which country launched its first domestically built aircraft carrier?
questions.solution: It was China who has in 2017 for the first time launched their indigenously built aircraft carrier type 001A CV17, which has taken their aircraft carrier number to two. It was Liaoning (CV16) which served as the first aircraft carrier of china, which they purchased from Ukraine and latter retrofitted it, as per their needs.

questions.question: ___________ is a welfare scheme started by the Prime Minister in order to provide LPG connections to domestic households that fall under the below the poverty line category.

options.text: Gram Uday Se Bharat Uday Abhiyan

questions.solution: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is a welfare scheme started in order to provide LPG connections to domestic households that fall under the below the poverty line category. In this, however the preference is given to SC/ST and weaker section of society. This measure will empower women and protect their health and will reduce drudgery and the time spent on cooking. It will also provide employment for rural youth in the supply chain of cooking gas.

questions.question: A _________ thread is actually stronger than a steel wire.
questions.solution: It is the Nylon thread, which is actually stronger than a steel wire. It belongs to the family of synthetic polymers and is a thermoplastic silky material, which can be melt-processed into fibers, and other material.

questions.question: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Rajya Sabha constituency) in Odisha.
questions.solution: Total parliamentary seats in Odisha stands at ten in number as mentioned in fourth schedule of the Indian constitution. Moreover, the number of seats in Rajya Sabha as per Article 80, is 250, of which 238 to be indirectly elected and the rest to be nominated by the president of India.
